title: Raider 125 TFT SmartXonnect (Performance Edition)
description: Representing TVS Motor Company's prowess in the Urban Roadster class, the TVS Motor Company Raider 125 TFT SmartXonnect (Performance Edition) is delivers muscular mid-range acceleration paired with effortless city maneuvering. A 125cc powerplant pumps out 16 HP and 13 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
